purpose: Recon evidence for the planned read-only avito/seller-reviews command. No cookies, tokens, account-private fields or full response bodies are stored.

entryPoint.visibleLink: a[data-marker="rating-caption/rating"] on the item page, href="#open-reviews-list"
entryPoint.note: The seller reviews list is a modal only. There is no separate reviews page: GET /user/<hashId>/reviews returned HTTP 404 (Ошибка 404. Страница не найдена).
entryPoint.notTheSame: a[data-marker="item-view/rating-badge-link"] points to /catalog/.../reviews-... which is reviews about the model, not about the seller.

params.fromItem: item ID, optional; changes the available sort vocabulary
params.limit: sent as 25 by the UI, ignored by the server (limit=2 still returned 25 rating entries)
params.offset: honoured; page size is fixed at 25
params.requiredFilters[]: sent by the UI on the first request instead of limit/offset

endpoint.keySource: buyerItem.rating.userKey from the same /items/ads{pathname} response avito/item already reads. 64-hex, distinct from buyerItem.seller.hashId (32-hex, used by /web/2/user/get-status/) and from the /brands/<id> or /user/<id>/profile route segment.
endpoint.sideEndpoint: GET /web/1/reviews/photogallery/user/{ratingUserKey}?fromItem=<id> is issued by the modal for the photo strip; not required for the review rows.

responseShape.score: { reviewCount, score, scoreFloat, subtitle, title, ratingStat[{score,count,title}], ratingAction{...write review...} }
responseShape.searchParametersV2: { blocks[{sort:{paramName:'sortRating', options[{label,value}], selectedOption}}, {inlineBoolFilter:{paramName:'photoOnly', label, selected}}], requiredFilters[] }
responseShape.info: section divider 'Отзывы без оценки' printed before unscored entries
responseShape.rating: { id, title (author), titleCaption (role), rated (visible relative date text), stageTitle, itemTitle, textSections[{text}], score?, images[]?, answer?{answerId,answered,title,text,link}, deliveryTitle?, avatar{} }
responseShape.nextPage: same path with offset advanced by 25; absent when the feed is exhausted

privateSample.note: Unscored entries carry stageTitle 'Не договорились' and no score field. reviewCount/summary count scored reviews only; activeReviewsCount counts every returned entry.

silentAcceptance: Unknown ratingUserKey → HTTP 200 with {"entries":[]}, not 404. A wrong key is indistinguishable from an empty feed by status alone.
Unknown sortRating (nonsense_desc) → HTTP 200, silently served as date_desc; searchParametersV2.selectedOption reported the applied value.
goods_relevant_desc without fromItem → silently served as date_desc and absent from the advertised options.
offset far beyond the feed (100000) → HTTP 200 with {"entries":[]} and no nextPage.

zeroReviewSeller.observed: buyerItem.rating === null, so no ratingUserKey exists at all; search rows show sellerRating/sellerReviewsCount as null.

requestBudget.primingProof: From a fresh browser session primed only with https://www.avito.ru/robots.txt, both /items/ads{pathname} and /web/7/user/{key}/ratings returned 200 application/json.
requestBudget.plannedCost: robots.txt + /items/ads{pathname} + one /ratings GET = three requests per invocation

sessionHealth: No HTTP 429, no QRATOR page and no CAPTCHA during the whole recon; every probe returned 200.
